answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing: the bus dies at ensure_database for want of PostgreSQL, not for a spawn defect; measured on yoga (bus.log: psycopg2.OperationalError ... 127.0.0.1:5432 Connection refused 10061). If a Windows box with PostgreSQL still cannot bring a bus up, that cause is ticket 3249018fbe8b's, not this seam's.
answers.builder_check: The builder has the seam file (commons branch windows-postgres-host-seam @86b66c7e) carrying the apply steps 1-6 and the verify; it needs Akien's run of step 2 on yoga, and a Windows box to measure clause 2. Nothing else.
answers.children: none, because the one host-seam intention file is the whole change
answers.collision_check: Outline 11.3.5 (PostgreSQL is a host service installed and upgraded by Recovery), 11.3.5.1 (each box keeps its own database) and 6.3.5 (the installer walks host-seams). No intention conflicts; akiendell already runs the same shape (postgresql-x64-17 Running/Automatic).
answers.falsifier_check: Three clauses: the seam's verify exits 0 on a Windows box after the apply; on that box a scratch-HOME /sorted cast reaches CodeMother over the scratch bus and lands (a local-fallback cast that skips CodeMother does not count); the same proof stays green on Linux. Horizon: until the PostgreSQL major version or the db_domain pgpass location changes; the seal expires with host drift.
answers.gates_bound: host-seam: POCME (the apply recipe replayed on a Windows box) and PROVEME (the re-runnable verify), PROVED exit gate (verdict); the seal expires with host drift; feeds back to origin on failure.
answers.missing_check: Step 2 of the apply is Akien's one elevated winget command (the EDB installer's own UAC prompt); every other step runs unprivileged. The seam's verify is red-first on yoga ('RED: nothing on 5432').

bullets.text: No Windows box without PostgreSQL can cast a ticket: the scratch bus dies at ensure_database, so the /sorted door's ask of CodeMother never gets an answer.
